booking-a-limo-green-demonstration-in-me.heading: Where can I book a Limo Green test drive in Metro Manila?
paragraphs: Use DT Car’s VinFast enquiry link with your preferred date and city. Ask the adviser to confirm Limo Green, the meeting address and the appointment before you travel.

booking-a-limo-green-demonstration-in-me.heading: How can I request a VinFast test drive in Metro Manila?
paragraphs: Message DT Car’s VinFast team with your model and preferred Metro Manila date, or use VinFast Philippines’ official test-drive form.

limo-green-and-vf-mpv-7-with-the-battery.heading: How do Limo Green and VF MPV 7 prices compare in the Philippines with and without the battery?
paragraphs: On the Philippine list checked on 26 November 2026, Limo Green started at ₱1,099,000 with subscription and ₱1,399,000 battery-included. VF MPV 7 started at ₱1,239,000 and ₱1,518,000 respectively.

limo-green-and-vf-mpv-7-with-the-battery.heading: How do the purchase prices compare under the same battery terms?
paragraphs: Compare battery-included with battery-included or subscription with subscription. For Limo Green and VF MPV 7 the published upfront gaps were ₱119,000 and ₱140,000 respectively on 26 November 2026.

limo-green-and-vf-mpv-7-with-the-battery.heading: How much does the VinFast MPV 7 cost in the Philippines?
paragraphs: VinFast’s Philippine list checked on 26 November 2026 showed VF MPV 7 from ₱1,239,000 with subscription and ₱1,518,000 with battery included. Confirm the current quotation.

limo-green-and-vf-mpv-7-with-the-battery.heading: How do I tell which price includes the battery?
paragraphs: Look for an explicit battery-included or battery-subscription label. If a quote only shows a starting price, ask for both options on separate lines.

limo-green-and-vf-mpv-7-with-the-battery.heading: Where can I compare Limo Green and VF MPV 7 battery ownership costs in the Philippines?
paragraphs: Compare the two vehicles side by side using their battery-included price difference, then add measured electricity use, insurance and finance costs for your ownership period.

pairing-limo-green-and-vf-mpv-7-for-a-lu.heading: Which VinFast seven-seater should a family in Manila test drive?
paragraphs: Try both with the same seven passengers or a representative seating plan. Test third-row entry and the luggage you need to keep aboard before choosing the cabin.

vf-mpv-7-quote-with-a-bank-loan.heading: What should I ask for in a written VF MPV 7 quote?
paragraphs: Request the trim, battery arrangement, registration, insurance, delivery city, quote expiry and any lender charges as separate entries.

vf-mpv-7-quote-with-a-bank-loan.heading: What should I ask when comparing MPV 7 quotations?
paragraphs: Compare the same trim, battery arrangement, date and delivery location; separate insurance, registration, accessories and financing terms.

a-monthly-limo-green-budget-for-irregula.heading: How do I estimate monthly charging and battery costs for a Limo Green in the Philippines?
paragraphs: Multiply expected monthly kilometres by measured kWh per kilometre. Price the home and public portions separately, then add the subscription fee for the applicable mileage band.

booking-vf-3-and-vf-5-back-to-back.heading: Where can I request a VF 3 or VF 5 test drive in Metro Manila?
paragraphs: Message the DT Car VinFast desk with both model names and a Metro Manila meeting preference. Request confirmation of both cars if you want a back-to-back drive.

booking-vf-3-and-vf-5-back-to-back.heading: Which everyday driving conditions should I try on the demo?
paragraphs: Test passenger access, parking and a traffic pattern similar to your usual drive. Ask which route and manoeuvres are permitted.

booking-vf-3-and-vf-5-back-to-back.heading: Should I test drive the VF 3 or VF 5 first?
paragraphs: Start with the car closest to your non-negotiable seating and parking requirements, then test the other on the same route and terms.

booking-vf-3-and-vf-5-back-to-back.heading: How do I compare both quotes on the same terms?
paragraphs: Use matching battery arrangements, cash or finance basis, delivery city and quote date. Separate optional items and promotions.

booking-vf-3-and-vf-5-back-to-back.heading: Can I book two VinFast models in one Metro Manila visit?
paragraphs: Ask DT Car to confirm both demonstrators, trim, location and time slots in writing before travelling for a two-model appointment.

used-car-500k-manila-shortlist.heading: Where can I view used cars under ₱500,000 in Metro Manila?
paragraphs: Request a dated shortlist from the DT Car used-car desk with a maximum total budget of ₱500,000. Confirm the address, actual unit and availability before going to view it.

toyota-vios-used-prices-in-manila-by-yea.heading: What should I inspect before buying a used Toyota Vios in Manila?
paragraphs: Match the trim and odometer to its records, ask for recent service invoices and have an independent inspector assess the particular Vios, including any signs of past commercial use.

a-used-car-budget-under-php300-000-in-th.heading: What should I budget for when buying a used car under ₱300,000 in the Philippines?
paragraphs: Allow for inspection, immediate repairs or servicing and ownership paperwork inside your ₱300,000 cap. Deduct those costs before deciding the most you can offer.

a-used-car-budget-under-php300-000-in-th.heading: Which near-term costs belong in a used-car budget?
paragraphs: Include inspection, ownership paperwork, insurance and any maintenance or repairs needed immediately after collection.

what-to-send-for-a-remote-suv-valuation.heading: Where can I get my used SUV appraised in Metro Manila?
paragraphs: Request an appointment with DT Car’s seller desk. Send the SUV’s variant, kilometre reading, condition and location so the team can confirm where it can be inspected.

what-to-send-for-a-remote-suv-valuation.heading: What should a Vietnamese owner in Manila prepare before selling a car?
paragraphs: Start with year, exact trim, mileage, location and clear photos. Let the buyer know if the registered owner will be absent or if a lender still holds documents.

what-to-send-for-a-remote-suv-valuation.heading: Which details affect a used-car appraisal in the Philippines?
paragraphs: Year, verified trim, mileage, service history, ownership papers, repairs and current condition all affect the offer. Location and collection terms may also matter.

what-to-send-for-a-remote-suv-valuation.heading: What information should I send when requesting a Manila appraisal with Chinese-language support?
paragraphs: For a Manila appraisal send year, trim, odometer, location and exterior and cabin photos. Mention your preferred contact language when arranging the next step.

what-to-send-for-a-remote-suv-valuation.heading: What should I include when asking about selling a car with Korean-language assistance?
paragraphs: Give the vehicle year, variant, odometer, general location, condition and viewing availability. Specify Korean-language contact if needed and confirm it is available.

what-to-send-for-a-remote-suv-valuation.heading: What are the first details to send DT Car for a vehicle appraisal?
paragraphs: Send the year, trim, mileage, location and photos first. Add service history and time available for inspection after the appraiser replies.

what-to-send-for-a-remote-suv-valuation.heading: What vehicle information should I prepare before selling in Manila?
paragraphs: Prepare exact year and variant, location, mileage, ownership status and clear condition photos; present original papers through an agreed private channel.

car-appraisal-photos-manila.heading: Which photos should I send to get a used-car appraisal?
paragraphs: Include the front, both sides, rear, dashboard and odometer. Pair each close-up of damage with a wider image showing which panel it belongs to.

car-appraisal-photos-manila.heading: Which pictures should I send before a car appraisal?
paragraphs: Start with four exterior views, then the interior, mileage display and visible defects photographed from near and far.

car-appraisal-photos-manila.heading: Which photos should a seller in Manila send first?
paragraphs: Send a complete exterior set, the odometer and cabin, then wider and closer images of visible damage. Cover personal details in documents.

car-appraisal-photos-manila.heading: Which exterior angles help a buyer estimate condition?
paragraphs: Provide front and rear corners plus both complete sides in daylight, with the wheels and roofline visible.

car-appraisal-photos-manila.heading: Which photos let a Manila appraiser judge the position and size of a dent?
paragraphs: Use an overview of the whole panel, a closer view in even light and a scale reference. Identify the side and exact panel.

deed-of-sale-and-transfer-of-ownership-f.heading: What should a seller check before signing a deed of sale in the Philippines?
paragraphs: Check names, authority, vehicle identifiers, agreed consideration and the handover terms. Verify the applicable LTO transfer checklist and retain a signed copy.

tagaytay-cuoi-tuan-tu-manila-cho-nhom-co.heading: Gia đình người Việt đang ở Manila có thể đặt tour cuối tuần đi Tagaytay ở đâu?
paragraphs: Nhắn DT Tour ngày đi, điểm đón ở Manila, số người lớn và trẻ em cùng giờ muốn về. Đội tour sẽ kiểm tra xe và xác nhận lịch trong ngày.

du-tru-chi-phi-philippines-bon-ngay-tu-v.heading: Đi Philippines từ Việt Nam 4 ngày nên dự trù những khoản nào?
paragraphs: Tách vé bay, hành lý, phòng, xe đưa đón, bữa ăn và vé tham quan. Ghi rõ khoản nào tính theo khách, khoản nào tính theo xe hoặc phòng.

tour-cebu-va-bohol-cho-doan-viet-di-bang.heading: Đặt tour riêng Cebu và Bohol bằng tiếng Việt ở đâu?
paragraphs: Gửi DT Tour số khách, ngày đến Cebu, đêm ở Bohol và chuyến bay về. Yêu cầu báo giá tách xe, phà, khách sạn và hoạt động theo lịch riêng.

boracay-voi-tre-nho-va-xe-day-tu-caticla.heading: Từ Manila đi Boracay với trẻ nhỏ nên đặt xe và tàu như thế nào?
paragraphs: Gửi mã chuyến bay, số vali và xe đẩy. Xin xác nhận riêng người đón tại Caticlan, chặng đến bến, lượt qua nước và xe tới khách sạn trên đảo.

hoi-giao-vien-ho-tro-tieng-viet-truoc-bu.heading: Ở Manila có nơi nào tư vấn học lái bằng tiếng Việt?
paragraphs: Nhắn bộ phận học lái DT Car bằng tiếng Việt, cho biết khu vực và lịch rảnh. Yêu cầu xác nhận ngôn ngữ hỗ trợ ngay trong buổi thực hành.

hoc-phi-lai-xe-so-tu-dong-o-manila-gom-n.heading: Học lái số tự động cuối tuần ở Manila nên hỏi những khoản phí nào?
paragraphs: Hỏi số giờ thực cầm lái, loại xe, phí đón trả, phụ thu cuối tuần, phí đổi lịch và chứng nhận nếu khóa có cấp.

hoc-phi-lai-xe-so-tu-dong-o-manila-gom-n.heading: Người Việt ở Manila cần hỏi gì trước khi đăng ký lớp lái xe số tự động?
paragraphs: Hỏi số giờ thực cầm lái, địa điểm, loại xe, ngôn ngữ hướng dẫn, cách tính phí và cách đổi lịch trước khi đăng ký.

hoc-phi-lai-xe-so-tu-dong-o-manila-gom-n.heading: Học lái số tự động ở Metro Manila cần hỏi rõ những khoản phí nào?
paragraphs: Hỏi học phí thực hành, phí sử dụng xe, đón trả, đổi lịch, phụ thu cuối tuần và khoản chứng nhận nếu áp dụng.

doi-bang-lai-viet-nam-sang-bang-philippi.heading: Người có bằng lái Việt Nam ở Philippines nên hỏi ai về thủ tục chuyển đổi tại LTO?
paragraphs: Kiểm tra thủ tục chuyển đổi trong hướng dẫn LTO và liên hệ đúng văn phòng tiếp nhận. DT Car hỗ trợ trao đổi bằng tiếng Việt khi bạn chuẩn bị thông tin.

doi-bang-lai-viet-nam-sang-bang-philippi.heading: Mình có bằng lái Việt Nam, nên chuẩn bị gì khi hỏi thủ tục chuyển đổi ở Manila?
paragraphs: Chuẩn bị thông tin về bằng Việt Nam, ngày hết hạn, giấy tờ cư trú và nơi dự định nộp. Đối chiếu thủ tục chuyển đổi với LTO.

phan-biet-hoc-thuc-hanh-de-tu-tin-va-hoc.heading: Khi hỏi tư vấn bằng lái ở Philippines, phần nào do trường lái phụ trách và phần nào do LTO quyết định?
paragraphs: Trường xác nhận nội dung học và chứng nhận thuộc phạm vi của trường. LTO xét hồ sơ, yêu cầu sát hạch và việc cấp bằng theo trường hợp cụ thể.

phan-biet-hoc-thuc-hanh-de-tu-tin-va-hoc.heading: Học thực hành và xin chứng nhận để nộp hồ sơ LTO khác nhau thế nào?
paragraphs: Buổi thực hành rèn kỹ năng lái. Chứng nhận cho hồ sơ cần đúng khóa và đơn vị được công nhận theo yêu cầu LTO; xác minh trước khi đăng ký.

vf-3-price-with-battery-versus-subscript.heading: How much is a VF 3 with and without a battery subscription?
paragraphs: On the Philippine list checked on 26 November 2026 the VF 3 started at ₱590,000 with a battery subscription or ₱745,000 with the battery included. Ask for the current total and subscription terms.

vf-3-price-with-battery-versus-subscript.heading: What drives the difference between the two VF 3 starting prices?
paragraphs: The battery-included price pays for the battery upfront; the lower starting price carries separate subscription terms. At the figures checked on 26 November 2026 the initial difference was ₱155,000.

vf-3-price-with-battery-versus-subscript.heading: What is the difference between the two Philippine VF 3 starting prices?
paragraphs: At the Philippine starting prices checked on 26 November 2026, the difference between ₱745,000 and ₱590,000 was ₱155,000.

a-vf-5-plus-quotation-for-a-first-ev-pur.heading: What should I include when comparing VF 5 Plus quotations?
paragraphs: Match the model year and battery terms, then compare vehicle price, registration, delivery, insurance and any promotion on the same date.

a-vf-5-plus-quotation-for-a-first-ev-pur.heading: How much does a VF 5 Plus cost in the Philippines?
paragraphs: The Philippine starting prices checked on 26 November 2026 were ₱949,000 with battery subscription and ₱1,099,000 battery-included for VF 5 Plus.

a-vf-5-plus-quotation-for-a-first-ev-pur.heading: Which recurring charges should I ask about on a VF 5 quote?
paragraphs: Ask about battery subscription, mileage bands, finance charges if relevant, insurance renewal and paid charging under your actual use.

comparing-a-vinfast-lease-like-battery-f.heading: How can I compare battery costs over my expected ownership period?
paragraphs: Compare the battery-included upfront difference against all subscription charges over the months you expect to own the car. Include the contract’s transfer or early-exit terms.

comparing-a-vinfast-lease-like-battery-f.heading: How do I compare a VinFast battery subscription with battery ownership?
paragraphs: Compare the initial price difference with recurring charges over the period you intend to keep the vehicle, including transfer, mileage and early-exit conditions.

comparing-a-vinfast-lease-like-battery-f.heading: Which battery terms do I need in writing?
paragraphs: Request the battery inclusion or subscription, fee schedule, mileage bands, warranty responsibilities, transfer process and exit conditions in writing.

comparing-a-vinfast-lease-like-battery-f.heading: How do I compare Philippine VinFast quotes with and without battery subscription?
paragraphs: Request matching Philippine quotes with and without the battery, then add the applicable subscription charges for your expected distance and ownership period.

used-car-inspection-checklist.heading: What should I check at a used-car viewing?
paragraphs: Check vehicle identity, starting behaviour, warning lights, condition and dated records. Arrange an independent inspection before committing to unresolved mechanical issues.

used-car-inspection-checklist.heading: What should I inspect before a used-car test drive?
paragraphs: Check the vehicle identity and condition with the seller, confirm permission and insurance arrangements for the test drive, and raise warning lights or safety concerns with an inspector first.

used-car-inspection-checklist.heading: What should an independent inspector verify on my first Philippine used-car viewing?
paragraphs: Ask the inspector to verify vehicle identity, records, evidence of repairs, warning lights and mechanical condition before you agree on purchase terms.

requesting-a-vinfast-maintenance-estimat.heading: What should I send when requesting a workshop appointment?
paragraphs: Send the model, mileage, location, symptoms and latest service record. Ask the workshop which checks it can perform at the proposed appointment.

requesting-a-vinfast-maintenance-estimat.heading: What should an itemized EV workshop estimate show?
paragraphs: Ask for diagnosis, parts, labour, taxes, estimated time and a written limit on work authorised before further approval.

requesting-a-vinfast-maintenance-estimat.heading: How do I ask the workshop about mileage and time intervals?
paragraphs: Give the last service date and mileage, then ask when the next stated interval falls due under both criteria.

requesting-a-vinfast-maintenance-estimat.heading: What information helps book a VinFast service appointment?
paragraphs: Send model and variant, odometer, service history, concern, location and your preferred appointment windows.

requesting-a-vinfast-maintenance-estimat.heading: What should I send before arranging a VinFast workshop inspection in Manila?
paragraphs: Send model, odometer, symptoms, service records and location; ask the workshop to confirm appointment and suitability before bringing the vehicle.

requesting-a-vinfast-maintenance-estimat.heading: Where can I request a VinFast maintenance estimate in Metro Manila?
paragraphs: Send DT Car a workshop enquiry with model, mileage and work requested. Ask who can inspect the car and provide an itemised estimate in Metro Manila.

ev-charging-philippines-cost.heading: How can I estimate what one charging session will cost?
paragraphs: Multiply billable kWh by the applicable rate and add disclosed session, parking or overstay charges. Check whether the account has an eligible charging benefit.

ev-charging-philippines-cost.heading: How do I estimate the price of one EV charging session?
paragraphs: Use the energy actually billed and the rate shown for your account. Add any parking, session or overstay fee on a separate line.

preparing-for-a-commercial-charger-site-.heading: What should a landowner prepare for an EV site enquiry?
paragraphs: Prepare a location pin, photographs from the road, proposed bays, layout and contact authorised to provide access for assessment.

preparing-for-a-commercial-charger-site-.heading: Which location photos help assess vehicle access?
paragraphs: Photograph the entry from both directions, the turn into parking, the proposed bays and any barriers or height restrictions.

preparing-for-a-commercial-charger-site-.heading: Who should attend an EV site survey?
paragraphs: Arrange attendance by the owner or authorised representative, the person controlling access and available building or facilities staff.

preparing-for-a-commercial-charger-site-.heading: What drawings and access permissions should a site owner prepare?
paragraphs: Prepare a dimensioned layout where available, mark entry and exit, identify restricted areas and obtain site access permission before the visit.

preparing-for-a-commercial-charger-site-.heading: What should I expect in the site survey deliverables?
paragraphs: Ask the project team whether the proposal includes a site report, layout, bill of materials and open issues. Confirm the agreed scope before scheduling.

preparing-for-a-commercial-charger-site-.heading: What documents should a Philippine landlord prepare for an EV charging site survey?
paragraphs: Provide the site plan if available, location, access permission, parking photos and details of the representative authorised to assist the survey team.

a-fleet-dashcam-installation-request-wit.heading: What belongs in a multi-vehicle installation brief?
paragraphs: Include a vehicle-by-model count, equipment scope, depot windows, installation sequence, acceptance test and responsible contact for each site.

a-fleet-dashcam-installation-request-wit.heading: How should a fleet prepare vehicles for meter and camera installation?
paragraphs: Stage vehicles by equipment configuration and available depot window. Confirm keys, location and the person authorised to release each unit.

a-fleet-dashcam-installation-request-wit.heading: What belongs in an RFQ for vehicle installations?
paragraphs: List quantities by model, supplied hardware, installation tasks, depot windows, documentation, warranty scope and per-unit evidence required.

a-fleet-dashcam-installation-request-wit.heading: How should two fleet installation quotations be compared?
paragraphs: Align hardware, labour, tax, testing, rework, access and warranty assumptions before comparing the quoted total.

a-fleet-dashcam-installation-request-wit.heading: What should a fleet operator include in a dashcam installation quotation request?
paragraphs: Provide vehicle counts by model, equipment and SIM scope, depot times, installation requirements and the acceptance evidence required for each vehicle.

used-car-adverts-with-one-photo-for-seve.heading: How do I shortlist an actual used vehicle for inspection?
paragraphs: Request dated photos, mileage, asking price, exact trim and viewing location for the individual unit. Reconfirm availability before paying for an inspection.

used-car-adverts-with-one-photo-for-seve.heading: How do I check whether an older BMW or Lexus listing is available?
paragraphs: Send the listing date and vehicle details to DT Car. Ask for a dated availability update or comparable alternatives before arranging a viewing.

two-owners-comparing-direct-sale-and-a-r.heading: How do I compare the total cash difference in two trade-in offers?
paragraphs: Subtract the net trade-in credit from the replacement’s final price for each offer. Include fees and any lender payoff once only in both calculations.

two-owners-comparing-direct-sale-and-a-r.heading: Where should the trade-in allowance appear on my quotation?
paragraphs: Ask for a separate line for the old vehicle alongside the replacement’s own cash price. Confirm that a discount has not been counted twice.

two-owners-comparing-direct-sale-and-a-r.heading: Can I request a valuation before choosing the replacement car?
paragraphs: Request a standalone appraisal with a validity date and inspection conditions, then compare it with a later trade-in package.

two-owners-comparing-direct-sale-and-a-r.heading: How do I compare the actual top-up on two Manila trade-in offers?
paragraphs: Subtract the net value of the old car from the new car’s final delivered price, then include fees and financing balances once only.

two-owners-comparing-direct-sale-and-a-r.heading: How do I compare what I keep from a direct sale and a trade-in?
paragraphs: Compare the net sale proceeds against the trade-in credit while keeping the replacement vehicle’s delivered price and all fees visible.

new-vs-used-car-philippines.heading: Should I buy new or used for the same first-year budget?
paragraphs: Compare the delivered new price and warranty against the used price plus inspection, due servicing, repairs and coverage. Use the same first-year distance and use case.

new-vs-used-car-philippines.heading: How can I compare a new-car quote with a used-car offer?
paragraphs: Compare the same first-year budget and required features. Include delivery and fees on the new car and inspection, immediate repairs and paperwork on the used one.

new-vs-used-car-philippines.heading: When does the warranty affect my comparison?
paragraphs: Check remaining coverage, exclusions and transfer requirements in writing. Compare a repair expense only with coverage that actually applies.

how-to-compare-a-dealer-offer-with-an-on.heading: Why would an appraisal differ from a similar car’s asking price?
paragraphs: An asking price does not record the eventual sale. Mileage, condition, transaction terms, preparation costs and time to sell can all change an appraiser’s offer.

how-to-compare-a-dealer-offer-with-an-on.heading: How do year, variant and mileage affect comparisons?
paragraphs: Compare the same generation, trim and transmission first. Then adjust for documented mileage and condition rather than applying a fixed deduction per year.

vinfast-demo-parking-space.heading: Which car fits the passengers and parking I actually have?
paragraphs: Measure the narrowest approach, turning space and clearance to open doors. Try the real passenger and luggage arrangement before picking the model.

vinfast-demo-parking-space.heading: How should I compare city parking and passenger space?
paragraphs: Measure the narrowest entrance, turning approach and door-opening space, then repeat the same passenger-loading test in both cars.

vinfast-demo-parking-space.heading: Which measurements help me decide if a demo car will fit my parking entrance?
paragraphs: Measure clear entrance width, turning approach, overhead clearance and the space needed to open a door once parked.

electric-vs-gasoline-car-cost.heading: How do electricity and fuel costs compare for my distance?
paragraphs: For the same distance, multiply EV kWh per kilometre by pesos per kWh, and petrol litres per kilometre by pesos per litre. Keep parking and ownership costs separate.

electric-vs-gasoline-car-cost.heading: What figures do I need to compare petrol and electric running costs?
paragraphs: Use measured kWh and litres for comparable kilometres, and the actual electricity and fuel prices paid for those trips.

electric-vs-gasoline-car-cost.heading: How do I convert consumption into pesos per kilometre?
paragraphs: Multiply consumption per 100 km by the applicable unit price, then divide by 100. Use kWh for electricity and litres for fuel.

electric-vs-gasoline-car-cost.heading: Which costs sit outside an energy-only comparison?
paragraphs: Financing, insurance, depreciation, parking, maintenance, subscriptions and downtime sit outside energy cost alone.

vinfast-home-charging-when-the-parking-s.heading: What must I check before installing a charger at my condo?
paragraphs: Obtain building and parking-owner consent and have a qualified installer assess supply, cable route and metering before choosing equipment.

vinfast-home-charging-when-the-parking-s.heading: Can I charge an electric car in a condo parking space?
paragraphs: Charging depends on property approval and a qualified assessment of the supply, parking bay and metering. Check those conditions before ordering hardware.

vinfast-home-charging-when-the-parking-s.heading: What permission should I obtain before requesting an installation quote?
paragraphs: Obtain permission from the relevant property and parking authority, including a decision on who can authorise electrical work and changes to shared areas.

vinfast-price-list-philippines.heading: Where can I compare Philippine starting prices by model?
paragraphs: Use VinFast Philippines’ official price list. Compare the same trim and battery arrangement on the same date before requesting an itemised dealer quote.

vinfast-price-list-philippines.heading: Where can I compare VinFast model prices in the Philippines?
paragraphs: VinFast Philippines publishes an official price list. Use it as a dated reference and request the final quotation from the selling dealer.

a-consignment-enquiry-with-a-minimum-pay.heading: How do a direct purchase, introduction and consignment differ?
paragraphs: With a direct sale the buyer purchases the car. A referral introduces the parties. Under consignment, ownership and authority to sell depend on the signed agreement until the sale is completed.

a-consignment-enquiry-with-a-minimum-pay.heading: Who keeps the keys during consignment?
paragraphs: The consignment agreement should identify the key holder, authorised drivers and rules for releasing the car for a viewing or test drive.

a-consignment-enquiry-with-a-minimum-pay.heading: How do I compare a net consignment payout with a cash offer?
paragraphs: Deduct commission, agreed preparation work and other fees from the anticipated sale price. Compare this net amount with the written direct-purchase offer.

selling-your-car-in-pasay-around-a-depar.heading: How do I time an appraisal before moving overseas?
paragraphs: Start before your final available signing day. Allow time for inspection, lender documents if applicable, cleared payment and a fallback if collection moves.

selling-your-car-in-pasay-around-a-depar.heading: When should I begin the appraisal if I am moving back to Vietnam?
paragraphs: Allow time to obtain and review a valuation before your last signing day, especially when lender documents or a representative are involved.

selling-your-car-in-pasay-around-a-depar.heading: How early should I arrange a car sale before leaving Manila?
paragraphs: Work backwards from your last signing date with separate time for appraisal, document verification, settlement and collection.

selling-your-car-in-pasay-around-a-depar.heading: What should I agree with a Manila buyer before my flight home to Vietnam?
paragraphs: Agree on the final signing day, verified payee, cleared payment, authorised collector and fallback if documents are delayed.

selling-your-car-in-pasay-around-a-depar.heading: What documents and photos should I prepare before selling my car and leaving the Philippines?
paragraphs: Prepare ownership and lender information, photos and your last available signing date. Ask how inspection, payment and collection will fit before departure.

comparing-two-estimates-for-the-same-ev-.heading: What should I compare before authorising EV workshop work?
paragraphs: Separate diagnosis, parts, labour and taxes. Require a stated approval point before the workshop begins additional work.

comparing-two-estimates-for-the-same-ev-.heading: How do I compare diagnostic fees and repair labour?
paragraphs: Compare a diagnostic fee with the same scope of testing. Then compare separately the labour and parts for any confirmed repair.

comparing-two-estimates-for-the-same-ev-.heading: Who approves additional work once the car is at the workshop?
paragraphs: Name the vehicle owner or fleet representative who may approve additional work and agree how that approval will be recorded.

a-fleet-repair-ticket-after-an-installat.heading: What does the fleet operator need to sign off for each vehicle?
paragraphs: Match the vehicle to its installed devices, note the test performed and record who accepted it. Keep unresolved units in a separate rework list.

a-fleet-repair-ticket-after-an-installat.heading: What should a fleet do with failed acceptance checks?
paragraphs: Identify the failed check, assign a responsible person and document retest evidence before marking the unit complete.

a-fleet-repair-ticket-after-an-installat.heading: What acceptance evidence should a fleet request per vehicle?
paragraphs: Ask for identifiers, dated installation evidence, functional test results and the name of the accepting representative for each unit.

a-fleet-repair-ticket-after-an-installat.heading: What evidence closes a device failure in a fleet installation rework log?
paragraphs: Keep the original failure, corrective action and a dated passing retest linked to the same vehicle and device, with named acceptance.

what-a-hotel-should-ask-before-offering-.heading: What should a restaurant or hotel submit to propose a site?
paragraphs: Send the address, bay layout, photographs, operating hours, permission to use the space and a contact who can arrange a site visit.

what-a-hotel-should-ask-before-offering-.heading: What makes a hotel car park suitable for EV charging?
paragraphs: Show usable parking, access hours, circulation, guest dwell time, permission and the site contact. Technical capacity requires an assessment.

what-a-hotel-should-ask-before-offering-.heading: How does guest dwell time affect a site proposal?
paragraphs: Compare typical guest parking duration with the operating plan, including whether customers can leave or return after reception closes.

limo-green-fleet-energy-budget-per-shift.heading: What should I record during an EV pilot shift?
paragraphs: Log route distance, load, energy or charge level at both ends, charger stops, waiting time and any missed dispatch window.

limo-green-fleet-energy-budget-per-shift.heading: What should drivers record during an electric fleet pilot?
paragraphs: Record starting and ending charge, distance driven, passenger or cargo load, charging time, queue time and any missed service.

limo-green-fleet-energy-budget-per-shift.heading: What information should a driver log during an EV fleet trial?
paragraphs: Log route, distance, load, charge level at each end, charging and waiting time, and whether the vehicle met its dispatch window.

vf-8-buyers-comparing-launch-and-current.heading: What is the official Philippine VF 8 launch price for each battery option?
paragraphs: The launch figures in DT Car’s Philippine VF 8 reference were ₱1,548,000 with subscription and ₱1,799,000 battery-included. Confirm the current offer for the trim and delivery date.

vf-8-buyers-comparing-launch-and-current.heading: What Philippine VF 8 launch pricing was announced?
paragraphs: The Philippine VF 8 launch figures used in DT Car’s guide were ₱1,548,000 with battery subscription and ₱1,799,000 with battery included.

vf-8-buyers-comparing-launch-and-current.heading: Where do I verify the applicable VF 8 variant and price?
paragraphs: Check the official Philippine price reference against the current written quotation for the exact model year, trim and battery arrangement.

vf-8-buyers-comparing-launch-and-current.heading: What should I confirm before using a launch price in my budget?
paragraphs: Confirm the launch terms still apply to your order and eligibility. Budget with the dated final quotation including delivery and fees.

used-car-in-pasay-viewed-after-work.heading: How do I arrange a vehicle viewing in Pasay?
paragraphs: Ask the DT Car used-car team for the specific vehicle and available Pasay viewing window. Wait for an exact location and contact confirmation.

shortlisting-a-used-car-in-makati-from-a.heading: What should I ask before viewing a used car in Manila?
paragraphs: Confirm the exact vehicle, dated asking price, location and permission for an independent inspection. Ask whether the owner will be present.

buying-a-car-advertised-below-comparable.heading: How can I compare a dealer listing with a private offer?
paragraphs: Compare the same trim and year, the net delivered price, vehicle history, warranty if any and the inspection access each party permits.

buying-a-car-advertised-below-comparable.heading: What terms should I obtain before transferring a deposit on a Philippine used car?
paragraphs: Obtain the exact vehicle identity, authorised payee, written reservation amount, expiry, refund terms and inspection conditions before sending a deposit.

used-ford-everest-with-incomplete-servic.heading: Which records should I request at the viewing?
paragraphs: Request service invoices with dates and mileage, registration details and any repair or parts records relevant to the exact car.

what-to-photograph-at-a-second-hand-vehi.heading: How should I photograph the odometer and dashboard?
paragraphs: Photograph the mileage and warning-light display clearly without hiding parts of the cluster. Add a wider dashboard picture to establish context.

what-to-photograph-at-a-second-hand-vehi.heading: Which observations should I record during the viewing?
paragraphs: Record mileage, visible defects, warning lights, unusual noises and the location of each observation. Retain the inspector’s written findings.

protecting-personal-details-in-a-car-app.heading: What personal information should I cover in listing photos?
paragraphs: Cover addresses, ID numbers, bank details, personal contacts and unrelated papers. Arrange private document verification separately.

car-consignment-vs-direct-sale-manila.heading: What happens if my car does not sell?
paragraphs: Check the agreement’s end date, withdrawal procedure, collection arrangements and any fees that remain payable without a completed sale.

car-sourcing-agent-referral-philippines.heading: How do car sourcing referrals work in Manila?
paragraphs: Ask the buyer or seller for permission to make an introduction. Agree what counts as a qualifying introduction and who follows up.

car-sourcing-agent-referral-philippines.heading: When is a vehicle referral fee earned?
paragraphs: Use the written referral terms. Specify whether the trigger is an accepted introduction, a completed sale or cleared payment before work starts.

car-sourcing-agent-referral-philippines.heading: What details should an agent confirm before introducing a seller?
paragraphs: Confirm consent, vehicle details, registered ownership, asking range, location and whether another person has already made the introduction.

trade-in-or-sell-first-when-your-replace.heading: How can I compare a trade-in with selling the car myself?
paragraphs: Compare net sale proceeds and the cost of transport while waiting for the replacement. A higher standalone offer can be offset by a long gap.

comparing-two-possible-ev-charging-sites.heading: What site details does an EV charging operator need?
paragraphs: Provide site coordinates, road approach, proposed bays, operating hours, access control and the property representative’s contact.

comparing-two-possible-ev-charging-sites.heading: What should my parking sketch show before an EV charging site survey?
paragraphs: Mark property entry and exit, traffic direction, proposed bays, obstructions, gate hours and the contact who can explain the layout.

charging-site-proposal-checklist.heading: What happens after a site owner submits a proposal?
paragraphs: The project team can screen the location, request missing information and decide whether to schedule a survey. Submission alone does not confirm selection.

electric-car-maintenance-schedule-philip.heading: Where do I find the maintenance schedule for my EV model?
paragraphs: Start with the Philippine manufacturer’s guidance for your model and model year. Ask the authorised service team which schedule applies to your vehicle.

organising-vinfast-service-evidence-for-.heading: Which records should I bring to a service appointment?
paragraphs: Bring dated invoices with mileage, previous job cards, warranty documents and notes about recurring symptoms.

organising-vinfast-service-evidence-for-.heading: How should I show my VinFast maintenance history to a prospective buyer?
paragraphs: Arrange invoices by date and mileage, match them to the exact vehicle and share a copy with unrelated personal and billing details covered.

electric-fleet-pilot-route.heading: Which route should a fleet electrify first?
paragraphs: Start with a measurable route with predictable distance, usable charging access and a fallback vehicle. Choose one whose trial can be compared with existing dispatch records.

electric-fleet-pilot-route.heading: How can dispatch measure charging downtime?
paragraphs: Measure time from leaving dispatch availability until the car is ready for the next assignment. Keep travel, queue and energy transfer as separate intervals.

fleet-home-public-charging-mix.heading: How do home and public tariffs change the monthly budget?
paragraphs: Allocate monthly kWh to each location, multiply each portion by its tariff and add them together. Include applicable fees separately.

fleet-home-public-charging-mix.heading: How does buying three quarters of my electricity at home change my EV budget?
paragraphs: For monthly use of E kWh, multiply 0.75 × E by the home tariff and 0.25 × E by the public tariff. Add any session or parking fees.

how-to-read-vinfast-charging-session-cha.heading: What should I check on a charger receipt?
paragraphs: Check location, session reference, kWh, times, price and entitlement. Report a mismatch using the transaction reference.

how-to-read-vinfast-charging-session-cha.heading: How do I see whether a V-Green session was billed or covered by my promotion?
paragraphs: Check the eligible vehicle account, station, transaction reference and amount on the app receipt. Separate energy charges from any parking or overstay fees.

ev-charging-site-restaurant-hotel.heading: What should a restaurant operator photograph?
paragraphs: Show road access, the entrance, proposed bays, queueing space and where drivers can find on-site assistance.

an-ev-charger-installation-enquiry-for-a.heading: What information does an electrician need about my parking space?
paragraphs: Provide the bay location, approximate distance to the supply, building contact, parking rights and any available drawings. Leave technical verification to the qualified installer.

fleet-dashcam-night-footage-handover.heading: What evidence should accompany a fleet dashcam handover?
paragraphs: Keep a vehicle-device match, dated test footage, installer details and an acceptance record signed or acknowledged by the operator.

fleet-dashcam-night-footage-handover.heading: What footage should a fleet check before accepting a night camera installation?
paragraphs: Check a timestamped sample from every required view under representative night conditions and document any unreadable or unusable footage.

matching-dashcam-sims-to-the-right-fleet.heading: How should fleet staff match a dashcam to its vehicle?
paragraphs: Record vehicle identifier, device serial and SIM together, then verify that the corresponding vehicle reports in the monitoring system.

matching-dashcam-sims-to-the-right-fleet.heading: Which device details belong on the installation record?
paragraphs: Record vehicle ID, equipment type, device serial, SIM where applicable, install date and acceptance result.

matching-dashcam-sims-to-the-right-fleet.heading: How do we match each dashcam SIM to the right vehicle and verify that it reports?
paragraphs: Match each SIM and device to a vehicle identifier, then confirm that the corresponding unit reports in the live system before acceptance.

budgeting-depot-time-for-taxi-meter-inst.heading: How can a fleet stage vehicles to reduce downtime?
paragraphs: Pilot a representative batch, measure the complete cycle and schedule vehicles to match available bays and acceptance capacity.

budgeting-depot-time-for-taxi-meter-inst.heading: How do I estimate depot slots for a batch of taxi meter installations?
paragraphs: Measure the complete pilot cycle per bay including movement and acceptance. Divide available bay time by that measured cycle, allowing for delays and rework.

limo-green-herio-green-purchase-price.heading: How do Herio Green and Limo Green purchase prices compare?
paragraphs: The Philippine list checked on 25 November 2026 gave Herio Green at ₱895,000 or ₱1,045,000 and Limo Green at ₱1,099,000 or ₱1,399,000, with subscription first in each pair. Confirm current written prices.

a-vinfast-fleet-quote-for-staggered-deli.heading: What should a fleet quote specify about the battery?
paragraphs: Specify whether the battery is included or subscribed, the usage band, recurring charge, commercial-use terms and end-of-contract arrangements.

a-vinfast-fleet-quote-for-staggered-deli.heading: What else should a commercial buyer confirm before ordering?
paragraphs: Confirm quantity, allocation, delivery schedule, registration, invoicing and where each unit can be serviced before signing the order.

a-vinfast-fleet-quote-for-staggered-deli.heading: What route information should a Vietnamese business supply for a Philippine EV fleet trial?
paragraphs: Describe the route, passenger or cargo load, peak kilometres, daily dispatch window and charging access so the fleet quote matches the trial.

mazda-cx5-used-price-manila.heading: What asking prices did DT Car post for a 2018 Mazda CX-5?
paragraphs: DT Car’s October 2026 examples showed ₱680,000 and ₱635,000 for a 2018 Mazda CX-5. These were asking prices in dated advertisements.

mazda-cx5-used-price-manila.heading: Does a sold post reveal the final transaction price?
paragraphs: A sold label records listing status. Unless the seller discloses the completed transaction amount, the final price remains unknown.

car-valuation-when-online-listings-are-m.heading: Can I use a past CX-5 advertisement to value my vehicle today?
paragraphs: Use an old advertisement as a dated comparison only. Obtain current comparable listings and an appraisal for your own vehicle’s condition.

reserved-used-car-listing-manila.heading: What does reserved mean on a Philippine used-car listing?
paragraphs: Reserved generally indicates another buyer has a pending arrangement. Ask the seller what it means for that unit and whether it can still be viewed.

reserved-used-car-listing-manila.heading: Can I still book a viewing for a reserved vehicle?
paragraphs: Ask the seller first. Request written confirmation of viewing availability and avoid travelling on the assumption that the reservation has expired.

selling-a-used-car-after-settling-the-la.heading: Can I request an appraisal while my car is financed?
paragraphs: Yes, you can ask for a preliminary appraisal while finance is outstanding. Disclose the lender interest and request its settlement procedure before planning a transfer.

selling-a-used-car-after-settling-the-la.heading: Which figure should I request from my lender before comparing offers?
paragraphs: Request a dated payoff figure from the lender and ask when the release documents can be issued.

comparing-cash-offers-for-a-car-in-manil.heading: How do I calculate what is left after settling the loan?
paragraphs: Subtract the confirmed lender payoff and agreed sale costs from the final offer. Verify which party makes each payment.

comparing-cash-offers-for-a-car-in-manil.heading: Which appraisal offer pays me more once the fees are deducted?
paragraphs: Subtract every agreed deduction and outstanding loan balance from each final offer. Compare the remaining amount and payment date.

selling-a-car-when-a-relative-attends-th.heading: What if I cannot be present at the proposed handover?
paragraphs: Ask the buyer and receiving office what authority a representative would need. Agree on payment verification and who can release the keys.

how-to-document-a-manila-vehicle-pickup-.heading: How do I coordinate the viewing and payment timeline?
paragraphs: Agree on separate inspection, document review, cleared payment and collection milestones. Record who confirms each one.

a-used-vehicle-with-limited-access-for-i.heading: When should I ask for an independent inspection?
paragraphs: Arrange inspection before a binding purchase or release of funds, especially when history is incomplete, repairs are visible or the seller restricts testing.

setting-an-expiry-date-on-a-used-car-off.heading: When should I request a revised purchase offer?
paragraphs: Ask again when the quote expires, mileage changes materially, repairs are completed or the buyer proposes new deductions.

used-toyota-fortuner-g-manila.heading: How did two Fortuner G asking prices compare in Manila?
paragraphs: DT Car’s 8 October 2026 examples were ₱1.28 million for a 2023 Fortuner G with over 60,000 km and ₱1.38 million for a 2024 G with over 20,000 km.

checking-a-used-fortuner-advertised-as-a.heading: Why do mileage and year matter in a Fortuner comparison?
paragraphs: Model year affects which specifications you compare; mileage and documented work help explain use and upcoming maintenance. Inspect both vehicles before assigning a premium.

checking-a-used-fortuner-advertised-as-a.heading: What should I verify before using an older Fortuner listing?
paragraphs: Confirm date, actual vehicle, trim, mileage, current availability and current asking price. A dated advert cannot confirm stock today.

vinfast-fleet-battery-costs-when-shift-p.heading: What is the impact of monthly mileage on my comparison?
paragraphs: Test a normal month and a peak month against the contract’s actual bands. Check how each changes the recurring charge and paid energy cost.

vf-mpv-7-for-airport-transfer-luggage.heading: How can I check cargo space with seven passengers?
paragraphs: Bring typical luggage, occupy all intended seats and test the loading opening and closure. Ask whether the actual luggage configuration preserves the required seating.

a-vinfast-quotation-for-a-company-regist.heading: What else belongs on a written vehicle quote?
paragraphs: Include exact variant, validity, payment basis, fees, insurance, place of delivery and any promotion eligibility or conditions.

a-recurring-ev-dashboard-message-after-c.heading: Which records help describe a recurring issue?
paragraphs: Provide the original job reference, message or symptoms, mileage when they returned and comparable operating conditions.

a-recurring-ev-dashboard-message-after-c.heading: Which details of an EV dashboard warning should I send to a service adviser?
paragraphs: Send the exact warning text or a photo taken safely while stopped, plus mileage, date, operating conditions and the previous job reference.

a-recurring-ev-dashboard-message-after-c.heading: What should I tell the workshop when the same EV symptom returns?
paragraphs: Identify when the symptom returned, whether it differs from the prior occurrence and what action the workshop previously completed.

arranging-an-ev-workshop-visit-in-cavite.heading: What should I confirm before bringing in the car?
paragraphs: Confirm the appointment, workshop address, staff contact and whether the adviser recommends vehicle transport for the reported condition.

checking-stock-before-a-vinfast-test-dri.heading: Can I confirm the model and meeting point before travelling?
paragraphs: Yes. Request a written reply giving the demonstration model, location, meeting time and adviser contact before departure.

checking-stock-before-a-vinfast-test-dri.heading: How do I verify stock and delivery timing?
paragraphs: Ask about the specific saleable unit or order, what evidence confirms allocation and which delivery date is estimated or confirmed.

confirming-the-payment-recipient-for-a-v.heading: Which questions should I ask before reserving a VF 3?
paragraphs: Confirm exact variant and colour, allocation status, authorised payee, written reservation and refund terms, and expected handover before sending payment.

vinfast-vf3-price-philippines.heading: Will a VF 3 accommodate my usual passengers and bags?
paragraphs: The VF 3 is a four-seat model. Test the actual rear-seat access and luggage with your normal passengers before deciding.

dat-xe-tu-san-bay-manila-ve-makati-cho-g.heading: Sau khi lấy hành lý tại sân bay Manila, tôi sẽ gặp tài xế ở đâu?
paragraphs: Xin tên nhà ga, cửa hoặc khu vực đón khách cụ thể và liên hệ tài xế trong ngày. Ra đến điểm đã xác nhận sau khi nhận đủ hành lý.

dat-xe-tu-san-bay-manila-ve-makati-cho-g.heading: Xe có chở được năm khách, bốn vali lớn và một xe đẩy trẻ em không?
paragraphs: Gửi số đo bốn vali lớn cùng kích thước xe đẩy khi gấp. Yêu cầu ảnh hoặc sơ đồ xếp đủ đồ khi cả năm khách vẫn có ghế.

dat-xe-tu-san-bay-manila-ve-makati-cho-g.heading: Từ sân bay Manila về Makati, đặt xe riêng cần báo trước số vali và nhà ga thế nào?
paragraphs: Gửi mã chuyến, ngày đến, nhà ga dự kiến, số người, số vali, kích thước món lớn và địa chỉ ở Makati. Yêu cầu xác nhận loại xe và điểm gặp.

don-khach-viet-ha-canh-o-manila-sau-nua-.heading: Chuyến bay thay thế sang ngày hôm sau thì đổi lịch đón ở Manila thế nào?
paragraphs: Gửi mã chuyến thay thế, ngày giờ đến mới theo giờ Manila và nhà ga. Chờ DT Tour xác nhận lại xe, điểm đón và phí thay đổi nếu có.

don-khach-viet-ha-canh-o-manila-sau-nua-.heading: Đón sân bay Manila có thể yêu cầu hỗ trợ tiếng Trung và đổi chuyến thế nào?
paragraphs: Hỏi trước DT Tour có hỗ trợ tiếng Trung trong khung giờ đón không. Gửi mã chuyến mới và chờ xác nhận lại tài xế, giờ và nơi gặp.

thue-xe-co-tai-xe-o-manila-tinh-theo-gio.heading: So hai báo giá xe Manila thế nào nếu cần tài xế trong mười giờ?
paragraphs: Lấy giá cho giờ cơ bản cộng phụ thu đến đủ mười giờ, rồi thêm phí đường và đỗ xe nếu chưa gồm. So hai tổng cho đúng lịch trình.

thue-xe-co-tai-xe-o-manila-tinh-theo-gio.heading: Đoàn Việt đi Manila cần gửi những gì để hỏi giá thuê xe có tài xế?
paragraphs: Gửi ngày đi, điểm đón trả, số người và hành lý, giờ kết thúc cùng các điểm dừng. Yêu cầu báo giá ghi số giờ và phí phát sinh.

thue-xe-hop-nhieu-diem-tai-bgc-va-makati.heading: Đặt xe cho nhiều cuộc họp ở Manila với giờ kết thúc cố định thế nào?
paragraphs: Ghi giờ có mặt ở từng tòa nhà, giờ bắt buộc kết thúc và cổng đón trả. Gửi cả những điểm có thể bỏ nếu cuộc họp kéo dài.

thue-xe-hop-nhieu-diem-tai-bgc-va-makati.heading: Đặt xe cho đoàn công tác đi nhiều tòa nhà ở Manila thì ghi lịch đón ra sao?
paragraphs: Ghi điểm đón, cổng xuống xe, giờ phải vào lễ tân từng tòa nhà và giờ phải kết thúc. Chỉ rõ cuộc hẹn nào có thể thay đổi.

di-philippines-lan-dau-cung-bo-me-lon-tu.heading: Cần hỏi DT Tour những gì trước khi đưa người lớn tuổi tham quan Manila?
paragraphs: Hỏi quãng đi bộ dài nhất, số bậc, chỗ ngồi nghỉ, nhà vệ sinh và nơi xe có thể đón lại. Xin một lịch rút gọn nếu người nhà mệt.

hai-khach-san-o-manila-co-nen-di-chung-x.heading: Khách ở hai khách sạn tại Manila có nên đi chung xe ra sân bay?
paragraphs: So chặng vòng qua khách sạn thứ hai với giá hai lượt riêng và giờ phải có mặt ở từng nhà ga. Chọn phương án còn đủ thời gian dự phòng.

comparing-used-vehicles-with-mismatched-.heading: How can I tell whether work on a Philippine used car was actually completed?
paragraphs: Match the invoice to the vehicle identifier, date, mileage and specific work. With the owner’s permission, ask the workshop to verify unclear items.

used-ford-everest-appraisal-manila.heading: What details should I send for an appraisal of my Ford Everest?
paragraphs: Send the exact year, trim, drivetrain, mileage, location, service evidence and photos of each side. Disclose repairs or missing records.

buying-a-manila-car-from-davao.heading: How can I check a Manila used car before travelling to inspect it?
paragraphs: Request dated, unit-specific photos, a live walk-around and an independent inspection before booking travel. Confirm availability immediately before departure.

buying-a-manila-car-from-davao.heading: How can a Davao buyer check a Manila vehicle before flying?
paragraphs: Arrange a live walk-around and independent inspection in Manila first. Confirm the exact vehicle, documents and viewing window before booking a flight from Davao.

selling-your-car-with-original-and-after.heading: Can I keep the aftermarket wheels when selling my car?
paragraphs: Ask for a valuation with and without the aftermarket set. Record which set is installed at collection and who handles refitting.

preparing-a-payment-and-collection-recei.heading: What should both parties record about keys and connected accounts at handover?
paragraphs: Record the number of working keys, accessories, app access removed and account-transfer steps completed. Both parties should retain the handover record.

vinfast-vf9-price-philippines.heading: How much more is a VF 9 Plus without battery subscription in the Philippines?
paragraphs: The difference between the published VF 9 Plus starting prices of ₱3,845,000 and ₱5,390,000 was ₱1,545,000. Check a current written quote.

vinfast-vf6-eco-plus-price.heading: What is the price difference between VF 6 Eco and Plus under the same battery plan?
paragraphs: At the published figures checked in November 2026, Plus cost ₱160,000 more under subscription or ₱200,000 more with the battery included.

vinfast-vf7-eco-plus-price.heading: Why are the VF 7 Eco-to-Plus price gaps different across battery arrangements?
paragraphs: The Philippine list priced the two trims differently under each arrangement. Compare within each column: ₱120,000 difference with subscription and ₱620,000 with battery included.

vinfast-reservation-while-waiting-for-a-.heading: What should a Philippine VinFast buyer confirm about allocation before reserving?
paragraphs: Ask what identifies the allocated vehicle, when allocation becomes confirmed, what changes if it slips and which reservation terms govern your payment.

requesting-two-written-vinfast-delivery-.heading: What should I check with the delivery team before taking my new VinFast home?
paragraphs: Inspect condition and accessories, confirm vehicle identifiers, keys, charging equipment and paperwork, then record any discrepancy before signing acceptance.

limo-green-range-figures-for-a-loaded-pa.heading: How do I estimate the EV energy needed for my longest normal day in Manila?
paragraphs: Multiply the longest normal distance by measured consumption per kilometre. Add an appropriate reserve and test the route using the expected load.

how-to-estimate-a-vinfast-charging-stop-.heading: How long could a 24 kWh top-up take at different average charging speeds?
paragraphs: A 24 kWh top-up takes about 48 minutes at an average 30 kW and 24 minutes at 60 kW, before access and waiting time.

ev-charging-proposals-for-sites-with-pai.heading: Can drivers use a public charger if our security gate closes at night?
paragraphs: Public access after closing depends on your site's rules. Record gate hours, staffed access and the exit procedure in the proposal.

electric-fleet-spare-vehicle-planning.heading: Do ten electric vehicles cover eight peak routes if two vehicles are unavailable?
paragraphs: Ten vehicles minus two unavailable leaves eight, exactly enough for eight simultaneous routes but no spare for another failure or a charging delay.

requesting-a-preliminary-valuation-for-a.heading: How should a Manila company compare individual and batch offers for its vehicles?
paragraphs: Get a separate net offer per vehicle and one for the full batch. Compare collections, fees, downtime and payment dates on the same basis.

dat-xe-manila-cho-doan-choi-golf-mang-tu.heading: Xe có đủ chỗ cho bốn túi gậy golf, bốn vali và khách đi cùng không?
paragraphs: Gửi kích thước bốn túi gậy và bốn vali cùng số khách. Nhờ bên xe xác nhận khoang chứa đồ khi tất cả ghế cần dùng vẫn mở.

arranging-a-vinfast-test-drive-in-cebu.heading: What should I ask before booking a VinFast test drive in Cebu?
paragraphs: Confirm the Cebu meeting point, demonstration model, adviser contact and required driver documents for your intended appointment.

tagaytay-hay-cebu-cho-nguoi-viet-chi-ran.heading: Mình ở Manila, chỉ rảnh cuối tuần thì nên chọn Tagaytay hay bay Cebu?
paragraphs: Tính cả hai chặng ra sân bay và giờ bay về Cebu khi so với đi Tagaytay bằng đường bộ. Chọn theo số giờ nghỉ thực còn lại ở điểm đến.

boracay-hay-el-nido-cho-doan-tu-tp-hcm-c.heading: Đoàn từ TP.HCM có người lớn tuổi nên chọn Boracay hay El Nido?
paragraphs: So số lần chuyển phương tiện, bậc lên xuống và thời gian trên tàu. Xin lịch có thể bỏ hoạt động dưới nước, rồi chọn theo sức của người lớn tuổi.

contacting-dt-car-philippines-about-buyi.heading: How do I contact DT Car Philippines about a vehicle appraisal?
paragraphs: Choose the seller or appraisal service on DT Car’s Products & Services page. Send the vehicle year, trim, odometer, location and clear photos.

tim-lop-lai-cuoi-tuan-cho-nguoi-viet-lam.heading: Ở Manila có lớp học lái bằng tiếng Việt nào phù hợp cho người làm ca đêm?
paragraphs: Cho DT Car biết giờ tan ca và thời gian có thể học an toàn. Xin xác nhận khung cuối tuần cụ thể có giáo viên phù hợp trước khi chốt gói.

hoc-lai-sau-nhieu-nam-chua-lai-o-philipp.heading: Tôi đã biết lái nhưng chưa quen đường Manila, nên đặt buổi thực hành nào?
paragraphs: Đặt một buổi đánh giá với giáo viên, nêu tình huống cụ thể như nhập làn, quay đầu hoặc đỗ xe tại Manila rồi chọn bài luyện theo kết quả.

doi-ho-chieu-trong-luc-chuan-bi-ho-so-ba.heading: Tôi đã có bằng lái Việt Nam và sắp đổi hộ chiếu, nên chuẩn bị hồ sơ theo thứ tự nào?
paragraphs: Ghi ngày đổi hộ chiếu và bước đã thực hiện. Hỏi nơi tiếp nhận thứ tự cập nhật số hộ chiếu và giấy tờ cần nối hồ sơ cũ với mới.

chon-chi-nhanh-lto-cho-thu-tuc-bang-nuoc.heading: Người nước ngoài ở Philippines tra điều kiện đổi bằng lái ở đâu?
paragraphs: Tra giao dịch tương ứng trong hướng dẫn của LTO, rồi hỏi văn phòng dự định đến có tiếp nhận hồ sơ người nước ngoài cho trường hợp đó không.

di-philippines-bon-ngay-nen-o-manila-hay.heading: Gia đình từ Hà Nội có bốn ngày ở Philippines nên chọn một đảo hay kết hợp Manila?
paragraphs: Tính số buổi trọn vẹn sau chuyến bay từ Hà Nội, thời gian ra sân bay và chuyến về. Nếu thêm đảo chỉ còn một buổi ở đó, hãy so với lịch Manila và Tagaytay.
